description: Department of Trade & Investment of Policy - Regulations made to fix the method for determination of Cost of Freight of Chartered Vessels registered under the Sri Lanka Flag for Customs Valuation Purpose effective from 23.11.2016
categorisation: This gazette notification contains regulations under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) that establish a method for determining the cost of freight for customs valuation purposes. It involves legal/regulatory matters including the repeal of a previous gazette notification and establishes compliance requirements for importers, fitting the definition of Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5). While it mentions the Minister of Finance by name, it does not contain detailed portfolio responsibilities or personnel changes, and the primary content is regulatory in nature.
